title: Infinite transitivity and polynomial vector fields
summary: We prove that for many pairs $H_1, H_2$ of root subgroups of the automorphism group $\text{Aut}(\mathbb{C}^2)$ the diagonal action of the group generated by $H_1, H_2$ on $(\mathbb{C}^2)^m$ has an open orbit for any positive integer $m$. The result is based on the study of the Lie algebra of polynomials in two variables with the standard Poisson bracket.
